status: proposed Rust API; reference characterization observed
scope: complete fossilize/defossilize primitives only; no artifact grammar

apis.meaning: Encode all slice bytes, including embedded NUL; Rust result excludes C terminator. Corresponds to nonnegative C nIn equal to slice length.
Encode bytes preceding first NUL, or all supplied bytes when absent (adapter supplies sentinel). Corresponds to defined negative-nIn strlen mode.

result.bytes: Vec<u8>: complete decoded prefix, including decoded NUL and subsequent emitted bytes
result.c_string_len: usize: index of first decoded NUL or bytes.len(); C consumers see bytes[..c_string_len]

apis.meaning: Stop input at first NUL or slice end. Decode n,s,t,r,v,f,0,backslash; unknown escape drops slash; terminal slash survives. No UTF-8 requirements. bytes length is new safe API metadata derived from algorithm; C returns void, so no inherited native decoded length exists.

compatibility.encoding: NUL=>backslash0, space=>backslashs, TAB=>backslasht, LF=>backslashn, CR=>backslashr, FF=>backslashf, VT=>backslashv, backslash=>double backslash; all other bytes unchanged.
compatibility.nul: Decoded NUL does not stop native loop: reading advances through original source bytes. Later C-string users see prefix only. Native backing buffer also retains stale trailing storage after new terminator; that stale storage is not decoded output.
compatibility.no_slash: Native decoder returns without writing when no slash occurs before initial NUL. New result contains unchanged input prefix.
compatibility.lengths: Explicit C lengths 0..buffer.len characterized through Rust slicing; reject out-of-bounds length if exposing an indexed helper. C negative length means strlen, not a negative slice length.
compatibility.excluded_undefined_inputs: No unterminated C strings, invalid pointers, explicit lengths beyond allocated storage, signed-int output overflow or real allocation exhaustion. Rust safe memory/size errors are not claims about C UB or process allocation failure.

reference.suite: new scratch characterization, not an inherited Fossil suite
reference.native_output: Entire n+1-byte post-decode backing buffer plus native strlen; encoding output bytes plus native strlen.
reference.derived_output: expected_emitted_hex and emitted length are independent source-derived scan results checked against native buffer prefix/full mutation; never attributed to a C return value.
